intro: Master Gadrin of Sen'jin Village tasks Horde champions with traveling to the Echo Isles to end the treachery of the witch doctor Zalazane. Driven mad by dark magic, Zalazane enslaved his fellow tribesmen and seized the Darkspear trolls' rightful home, forcing them into exile on Durotar's coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east. They are the isles we once called home.
From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.
Defeat Zalazane and his minions—former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us. Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace. Thank you, friend. The Darkspear tribe owes you much. If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me. His voodoo is strong...
